title: Ankhorage AWS EC2 Infrastructure
summary: Provides a secure, provider-neutral AWS EC2 compute adapter backed by the modular AWS SDK v3 client.
purpose: Translate provider-neutral compute lifecycle intent into explicit, ownership-verified AWS EC2 operations without leaking credentials into portable state.
responsibilities: Validate, inspect, plan, reconcile and destroy owned EC2 instances.
Project verified SSH compute targets for runtime adapters.
Apply secure EC2 defaults including IMDSv2 and encrypted root EBS volumes.
boundaries: Does not provision VPCs, subnets, security groups, IAM roles, profiles or S3 buckets.
Does not deploy Kubernetes, Docker workloads, HydraDB or any application.
Does not persist AWS or SSH credential values.
audience: Infrastructure hosts selecting AWS EC2 through the canonical Infra compute interface.
Operators provisioning reusable SSH-capable compute targets on AWS.
useCases: Provision a securely configured EC2 instance through the common compute adapter.
Inspect or reconcile owned EC2 instance state without a local ledger.
Expose a host-key-verified SSH target to a runtime adapter.

architecture.role: A cloud compute adapter translating Infra lifecycle operations into isolated AWS SDK and SSH boundaries.
invariants: AWS and SSH credentials remain transient execution inputs.
Public results conform to the provider-neutral Infra compute contract.

configuration: Existing network, security groups, SSH key pair and optional IAM profile must be explicitly selected.
security: The adapter requires encrypted root EBS storage, IMDSv2 and explicit SSH source restrictions.
limitations: Live AWS acceptance requires separately authorized non-production credentials.
